gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-smooch-sans: Funnel Display draws its letters like fine rope, one strand of constant width looping into each shape. And Smooch Sans is sans-serif and tightly packed, its lines nearly closing the gaps, so a long run of text reads dense, tidy and quick.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-sofia-sans-cond: Sofia Sans Condensed reads as a plain sans with a big x-height and curves that stop before closing their loops. Its strongest quality is that friendly, tall-bodied efficiency, and Funnel Display adds a rope-like swagger above it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-spline-sans-mon: Strands of constant width, looped into letters, give Funnel Display its spaghetti-like look. Spline Sans Mono answers in fixed-width monospace, bold and uniform, so the loose heading and the rigid, code-like text keep each other honest.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-tiny5: Tiny5 is tall enough that its ascenders look short, a plain sans with a clean, approachable face. Its strongest quality is that stature, and Funnel Display gives it a commanding, rope-like heading to stand beneath.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-truculenta: Truculenta packs short ascenders and a tall x-height into a compact sans line, with rounded forms that stay open to the side. Funnel Display's looped, rope-like strokes sit over it and loosen things up.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-ubuntu: Ubuntu is a plain sans with a lofty lowercase band. Over many lines it feels modern and businesslike, the tall letters moving the eye along while Funnel Display's smooth, hairline-free strokes stay above.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-victor-mono: Funnel Display looks like spaghetti laid into letters, every stroke the same width. It is built to command attention, while Victor Mono, a monospace with loose spacing and bowls left open on one side, is built to be precise and structured.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-viga: Rope-like, constant strokes and c tips that never close in mark Funnel Display. It does expressive, commanding display work best, while Viga, a sans with hairline-free strokes and barely taller capitals, quietly handles the neutral, professional text.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-voces: Professional in mood, Voces stands tall in its lowercase, a plain sans with only mild thick-thin variation. And Funnel Display does the loud work, its constant-width pen line carrying the expression while the body simply informs.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-winky-rough: Winky Rough keeps its body height almost level with its capitals, giving a contemporary, professional sans-serif feel. Winky Rough over a longer passage would read dense and steady, with Funnel Display's one-tip, rope-like heading setting the tone above.
